slices.title: Prove the host Markdown round trip on a blocked item in a real session

open_points.input: One Todo document that runs `BLOCK "Wait on review" "reviewer silent"` and then, in the same or a later call, `START "Wait on review"` (or `DONE`/`DROP`); read `details.more`, the native card/HUD row, `omp-todo-more:read`'s `counts`, and `details.phases`.
outputs: The snapshot keeps `{status:"in_progress", blocker:"reviewer silent"}`: the card/HUD shows `Blocker: reviewer silent` on an active row while `counts.blocked` is 0 and `details.phases` is `{content, status:"in_progress"}` with the blocker dropped (the literal reading of 结果 1 plus 结果 2)

Leaving `blocked` clears the blocker, so no record ever holds a non-blocked item with a blocker; that requires editing START/DONE/DROP in src/tool.ts, which 责任单元 says this child leaves alone (the plugin's five-value state and its writer stay as they are)
open_points.point: An item whose plugin status has left `blocked` but whose `blocker` is still set: 结果 2 speaks of blocked and blocker as one presentation while 结果 1 keys the projection on status alone, and the contract never says whether the plugin record keeps that orphan blocker or whether any code should clear it.
open_points.producer: <omomp>/omp-todo-more/src/tool.ts:269-282 (start/done/drop assign status and never touch `blocker`; only a BLOCK without reason at src/tool.ts:294 and UNBLOCK at src/tool.ts:307 delete it); the same combination enters the plugin from a pre-18.19 `user_todo_edit` record through src/state.ts:297 in joinNative, which copies `task.blocker` whatever the status
open_points.searched: grep `blocker` over src/, test/, index.ts; read all `applyOp` cases in src/tool.ts:265-330, hostPhases/joinNative/itemSnapshotSchema in src/state.ts:135-183,280-324; checked 范围边界's 「不在范围：插件自己的 BLOCK/UNBLOCK 语法、五值状态、卡片与 topic 文案」

open_points.input: An eval unit `await tool.todo({ input: "*** Begin Todo\nVIEW\n*** End Todo" })` in the sandbox session; read the bridge status line it emits.

`committed: true` — the literal reading of 结果 3, which would need either the plugin's VIEW result to stop carrying `op: "view"` or a host change; 范围边界 excludes both (plugin protocol untouched, host behavior untouched)
open_points.point: 结果 3 promises the eval bridge's status line reports `committed: true` without qualification, but the host refuses any result whose `details.op` is `"view"`, and a plugin VIEW result carries exactly that op.
open_points.producer: <omomp>/omp-todo-more/src/tool.ts:671 (`if (op === "view") return result(..., { op })`), with `RESULT_OPS` including `view` at src/tool.ts:48

open_points.input: After the driver's BLOCK, or after a direct (non-bridged) `todo` call that BLOCKs, read the host's list (`/todo`, `session.getTodoPhases()`, the TodoTracker projection built from `details.phases`) and the plugin's list (`branchFacts(manager).state`, the native card, the Tern HUD).
